create_blockint8_config: create a BlockInt8Config with dynamic activation scheme and weight block size for int8 quantization
build_blockint8_linear_method: build a BlockInt8LinearMethod to apply block-wise int8 quantization to a linear layer
build_blockint8_moe_method: build a BlockInt8MoEMethod to apply block-wise int8 quantization to a fused MoE layer
test_blockint8_from_config: test loading a BlockInt8Config from a JSON config dictionary with activation scheme and block size
run_blockint8_moe_apply: run a BlockInt8MoEMethod apply to dispatch and combine quantized MoE expert computations
